saved-plans-hint: Open a listen made here or by your connected agent.
plans-empty: No saved listens for this episode yet.
agent-plan-help: Your connected agent can read the transcript, create a version-bound listen, and give you its plan ID. Reload this list, then open the plan here to inspect every kept and omitted word before playing or exporting.
copy-instructions-error: The instructions couldn't be copied. Check clipboard access, then try again.
agent-instructions-copy: Read episode {{episodeId}}'s transcript, create a version-bound listen from your chosen passages, and return the saved plan ID so I can open and inspect it here.
plan-wrong-source: This saved plan belongs to a different episode, so it cannot be played or exported here.
plan-many-sources: This saved plan uses multiple episodes, so it cannot be played or exported from this episode workspace.
title: Hear only the parts you want
intro: Say what you want to hear and how long you have. Smart Play then skips the rest in your player, or you can export one MP3.
want: What do you want to hear?
mode-keyword-hint: Finds the words you typed. Works without AI.
mode-ai-hint: Understands what you mean. Uses your AI connection.
ai-off: AI needs a connection first. <settings>Connect AI in Settings → AI</settings>, or use keywords.
planning-ai: Planning with AI… On a free AI plan this can take a few minutes. You can keep listening.
no-transcript: No transcript for this episode yet
no-transcript-hint: Cuts are made from the transcript's timestamps.
empty: Nothing in this episode matched “{{want}}”. Try other words.
empty-queue: Nothing in your queue matched “{{want}}”. Try other words.
needs-timing: These can't be cut until the transcript's times fit your downloaded file:
make-from-file: Make a transcript from the file
making-from-file: Making the transcript… This takes a few minutes. You can keep listening.
make-off: Transcription is off on this server. Set TRANSCRIPTION_API_BASE_URL and TRANSCRIPTION_API_KEY in .env.
make-not-allowed: Only an admin can make transcripts. Ask the person who runs this server.
make-error: The transcript couldn't be made. Try again.
timing-unchecked-hint: These times weren't checked against your downloaded file. If a skip lands in the wrong place, make a transcript from the file.
over-budget-none_one: {{count}} passage matched, but it is longer than that. Allow more minutes, or ask for something narrower.
over-budget-none_other: {{count}} passages matched, but each is longer than that. Allow more minutes, or ask for something narrower.
over-budget_one: {{count}} more passage matched but didn't fit in {{minutes}} min.
over-budget_other: {{count}} more passages matched but didn't fit in {{minutes}} min.
update-error: That change wasn't saved. Try again.
script-label: What the cut keeps and leaves out
play-cut: Play the part that is cut, at {{time}}
smart-play-hint: Your player plays these parts and skips the rest.
smart-play-on: Smart Play is on in your player.
smart-play-error: Smart Play couldn't start. Try again.
smart-play-queue: Smart Play plays the episodes in order, skipping everything else.
download-first: Download it first, so the skips land in the right place.
download-first-list: Download these episodes first, so the skips land in the right place:
download-error: The download didn't finish. Try again.
download-not-allowed: Only an admin or an uploader can download episodes. Ask the person who runs this server.
export-hint: Export cuts exactly the words above, then listens to the MP3 to check every cut.
stage-waiting: Waiting for another export to finish…
stage-timing: Checking the transcript's timing against your file… {{percent}}%
stage-listen: Listening to your MP3 to check every cut… {{percent}}%
stage-fix: A cut was off, so it is being cut again from the original and checked again… {{percent}}%
export-timing-unchecked: Its timing was not checked against your audio file.
index-entry: {{cutStart}}–{{cutEnd}} in the MP3 · {{sourceStart}}–{{sourceEnd}} in the episode
download-failed: The MP3 couldn't be downloaded. Try again.
check-passed_one: Checked by listening: the cut starts and ends on the planned words, and the join has no dead air.
check-passed_other: Checked by listening: every passage starts and ends on the planned words, and none of the {{count}} joins has dead air.
check-passed-single: Checked by listening: the passage starts and ends on the planned words.
check-fixed_one: Checked by listening. One cut was off, so it was cut again from the original, and now every cut is right:
check-fixed_other: Checked by listening. {{count}} cuts were off, so they were cut again from the original, and now every cut is right:
check-problems_one: Listening to the MP3 found a problem it couldn't fix:
check-problems_other: Listening to the MP3 found {{count}} problems it couldn't fix:
check-problems-hint: You can still download it. Or play the original there, change the plan (remove the passage or add context), and export again.
check-audio-only: Checked for silence at the joins only.
check-words: Speech-to-text heard {{heard}} of the {{expected}} planned words; the rest differ in wording, not in audio.
check-words-plain: Speech-to-text heard {{heard}} of the {{expected}} planned words.
finding-clipped_start: Passage {{n}} starts too late at {{time}}: “{{words}}” is cut off.
finding-clipped_end: Passage {{n}} ends too soon at {{time}}: “{{words}}” is cut off.
finding-extra_start: Passage {{n}} starts too early at {{time}}: it plays “{{words}}” from the part you cut.
finding-extra_end: Passage {{n}} runs on at {{time}}: it plays “{{words}}” from the part you cut.
finding-wrong_audio: At {{time}}, passage {{n}} doesn't sound like its script: the transcript may not fit this audio file.
finding-low_match: Passage {{n}}: some of what speech-to-text heard is worded differently from the transcript.
finding-stt_missed: Speech-to-text didn't hear “{{words}}” at {{time}}, but the original audio there is intact.
finding-stt_extra: Speech-to-text heard “{{heard}}” at {{time}}, but the original has no such words there.
finding-transcript_differs: The transcript says “{{words}}” at {{time}}; speech-to-text doesn't hear it in the original either, so the cut is right.
finding-stuck: There's no clean place to cut here: the words run together or the speakers overlap.
fix-clipped_start: Passage {{n}} started too late; its start moved {{seconds}} s earlier.
fix-clipped_end: Passage {{n}} ended too soon; its end moved {{seconds}} s later.
fix-extra_start: Passage {{n}} started too early; its start moved {{seconds}} s later.
fix-extra_end: Passage {{n}} ran on; its end moved {{seconds}} s earlier.
fix-dead_air-start: Passage {{n}} started with extra silence; {{seconds}} s trimmed.
fix-dead_air-end: Passage {{n}} ended with extra silence; {{seconds}} s trimmed.
queue-intro_one: One plan across your Listen next queue: {{count}} episode, {{minutes}} min.
queue-intro_other: One plan across your Listen next queue: {{count}} episodes, {{minutes}} min.
queue-empty-hint: Add episodes to Listen next, then cut them here.
sponsors-on-none: Skip sponsors: on. No selected passages meet your skip settings.
sponsors-waiting: Skip sponsors: on. Download this episode first, so the skips land in the right place.
sponsors-loading: Skip sponsors: on. Looking for sponsor parts…
sponsors-error: Sponsor skipping couldn't load. Try again.
sponsors-needs-transcript: Skip sponsors: on. Open the episode's transcript to add timed words first.
sponsors-timing-unchecked: Transcript timing has not been checked against this audio. Choose skips manually.
sponsors-timing-mismatch: These timestamps do not match the loaded audio. Make a transcript from this file before skipping.
sponsors-manual-parts_one: {{count}} passage is available for manual skipping.
sponsors-manual-parts_other: {{count}} passages are available for manual skipping.
sponsors-unsure_one: {{count}} part is not skipped: its times may not match this file.
sponsors-unsure_other: {{count}} parts are not skipped: their times may not match this file.
sponsors-switch-error: The switch couldn't be saved. Try again.
notice-skipped: Skipped. Smart Play plays only your parts.
notice-next-failed: The next episode couldn't play, so Smart Play stopped.
sponsors-intro: Podsift finds these passages in the episode's own timed transcript. It looks for explicit sponsor announcements, offers and other clear cues, and keeps ambiguous passages. No community timing database is used. Choose which kinds to skip in downloaded episodes.
sponsors-timing-help: Automatic skipping uses timing from the audio file. Unchecked publisher timing always offers a manual choice. Undo skip replays a passage once without changing your preferences.
category-selfpromo-hint: Plugs for the show's own merch, Patreon or other shows
category-interaction-hint: Reminders to like, subscribe or follow
category-intro-hint: Short show greetings and marked opening music
category-outro-hint: Closing sign-offs and marked closing music
category-preview-hint: Explicit previews and recaps of other episodes
category-filler-hint: Transcript-marked pauses, asides and unintelligible speech
sponsors-save-error: Your change wasn't saved. Try again.
